summary: Retest of iteration 10's two outstanding frontend bugs + minor 3 + trader regression against the public preview URL (mobile 390x844). Bug 1 (trial 'X days left' on Discover) and Bug 2 (expired user paywall on Discover) are BOTH FIXED. Minor 3 (pay-apple on web) is STILL unresolved: the button shows the correct label 'Subscribe with Apple · $29.00/mo (simulated)' but remains aria-disabled=true indefinitely (polled every 2s for 10s) so the confirm-apple/cancel-apple modal cannot be reached on web. Root cause unchanged from iter 10: in src/revenuecat.tsx `identityReady` requires originalAppUserId not to start with '$RCAnonymousID:' AND upgrade.tsx disables pay-apple when `!rcPackage || !sub.identityReady`; the AuthGate calls Purchases.logIn(user.user_id) but on Browser Mode / Test Store the Purchases.logIn either does not update the cached customer-info to a non-anonymous id or React Query is not re-fetching, so identityReady remains false. The orange 'Linking your account to the App Store…' hint stays on screen. Trader regression: Discover shows 'Unlimited scans · advance plan' and the Scan markets button returns real results ('15 stocks · 225 setups priced · 5 passed · filtered by probability (66), liquidity (41), return (14)'). Deprecated packages detected: NONE. SafeAreaView issues detected: NONE. No React Native red screen. Credentials used: trader@optiscreen.app / TestPass123! (advance), fresh trial test_retrial_1792164146@optiscreen.app, backdated expired test_reexp_1792164146@optiscreen.app (both plan='free', questionnaire+consent completed, trial backdated 8 days).

integration_issues.issue: pay-apple button stays disabled (aria-disabled=true) for 10+ seconds because sub.identityReady never flips to true on web Browser Mode. Label is correct ('Subscribe with Apple · $29.00/mo (simulated)') and rcPackage resolves to the advance package, but upgrade.tsx:118 disables pay-apple when !sub.identityReady. AuthGate calls Purchases.logIn(user.user_id) in _layout.tsx:138 and writes customerInfo into the react-query cache, but originalAppUserId in that cached CustomerInfo apparently still starts with $RCAnonymousID: on web Test Store, so useSubscription.identityReady (src/revenuecat.tsx:76) stays false. Suggested fix: either (a) consider identityReady true whenever a known user_id has been passed to Purchases.logIn (track it in a ref) rather than inspecting originalAppUserId, or (b) relax the disabled guard on upgrade.tsx to only check !rcPackage (allow the simulated confirm modal to open on web even without a confirmed non-anonymous id), or (c) force a Purchases.getCustomerInfo() refetch after logIn so the cached originalAppUserId reflects the real user_id. Reference: /app/frontend/app/upgrade.tsx:118, /app/frontend/src/revenuecat.tsx:76, /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:133-151.

action_items: Fix pay-apple to be reachable on web preview: resolve sub.identityReady under Browser Mode (RevenueCat Test Store) OR relax the disabled guard in /app/frontend/app/upgrade.tsx line 118 to only require rcPackage so the simulated confirm-apple/cancel-apple modal is reachable. Preferred: in src/revenuecat.tsx replace `identityReady = !!originalAppUserId && !originalAppUserId.startsWith('$RCAnonymousID:')` with tracking of a successful Purchases.logIn in a ref/state, so identityReady becomes true as soon as AuthGate calls Purchases.logIn(user.user_id).

rca_of_issue: pay-apple disabled RCA: upgrade.tsx:118 ties the button's disabled state to `!rcPackage || !sub.identityReady`. On web preview Purchases is in Browser Mode / Test Store, and even after AuthGate calls Purchases.logIn(user.user_id) in _layout.tsx:138, the cached CustomerInfo written into React Query via `queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo)` still has an originalAppUserId beginning with '$RCAnonymousID:' (or the subscription-provider cache was populated earlier by an un-identified getCustomerInfo() query that then never refetched). Because `identityReady = !!originalAppUserId && !originalAppUserId.startsWith('$RCAnonymousID:')`, the flag never flips to true on web; the Button stays aria-disabled=true forever and the warning 'Linking your account to the App Store…' remains visible. Reproduction: log in on the web preview with any user, navigate to /upgrade, wait 10s, inspect pay-apple — aria-disabled=true. Mitigation (any of): (1) in SubscriptionProvider, after Purchases.logIn, invalidate/refetch the customer-info query so originalAppUserId updates; (2) derive identityReady from a locally-remembered `loggedInUserId` ref (set by AuthGate after Purchases.logIn resolves) rather than inspecting originalAppUserId; (3) in upgrade.tsx drop !sub.identityReady from the disabled guard — the confirm modal is already labelled 'simulated' on web, so letting it open is acceptable.
